scope: Unchanged PlasticCraft 2.1.3 single-player items, utility equipment, neutral entities, block callbacks/rendering, natural cows, native recipes/records and separate-process microwave/extractor GUI, packets and save/restart. Full dedicated multiplayer effects are outside this validated scope.

original_mod.configuration_comparison: All lines/values match Prism after normalizing Windows/Linux line endings. No options or mod versions changed.

generic_changes: Shared Beta food, armor, mining/durability and native result-slot callbacks invoke original item and ModLoader behavior; armor layers copy original AddArmor-prefix textures
Recipe result codecs retain full components and exact Beta metadata ingredients preserve implicit-zero, subtype and wildcard-damage semantics
Authoritative integrated-server frame callbacks refresh retained canonical views, flush dirty fields only and replay immutable HUD commands with original blending and depth state

Neutral entity hosts invoke original collision, interaction, rider and renderer callbacks; fluid-surface queries, boat geometry, typed TNT/falling timers and value-coordinate semantics match original APIs
Original block face/color callbacks, generated model tint indices, current neighbor sources and native vanilla signal-source identity are bridged generically
Native movement overrides preserve foreign attributes/modifiers; creating an existing native 1.12 entity view no longer reapplies constructor attribute defaults
Vanilla entity names resolve before replacement registrations, so explicit original ModLoader spawn removals and latest-registration replacement remain distinct

Remote machine menus reconstruct installed original public player-inventory/registered-tile GUI constructors with bounded tile/NBT context and exact slot-layout matching, then forward authoritative slot/progress packets
Original custom records use native jukebox song components, insertion/ejection, playback and item persistence; original texture animation callbacks update the stitched GPU atlas
Opt-in graphical harness accepts an explicit remote-server target for separate-process checks without starting an integrated server

visual_inspection.scope: Root inspected boat riding, worn armor, translucent goggles, colored world blocks, plexiglass/door/glow/Jello/Goo/trampoline, and remote machine GUI screenshots

preserved_original_behaviors: Utility boots/goggles explicitly set maximum damage and protection to zero; goggles supply only the original visual overlay, with no added lighting/potion effect
Original accelerator multiplies motion, Jello heals six times, and original Goo/trampoline thresholds and timers are retained
Original C4 stores signed-byte Fuse only; enhanced power/count/scale omission is not changed
Original machine containers omit property 2 and custom shift-click; recipe capacity/fuel-denominator quirks are retained
Beta natural spawn candidate Y remains 0..127; the invalid negative-Y superflat fixture was replaced by an above-zero test habitat
Vanilla/native behavior is altered only by an explicit original mod callback or spawn removal; no global Beta spawn or attribute defaults are imposed
boundaries: Actual tests use disposable isolated worlds and the unchanged original mod, not every mod/version combination

Native single-player utility/effect hooks are established; dedicated OnTickInGame ownership, cross-player global state and full multiplayer gameplay remain unimplemented and are not claimed by machine synchronization checks

Dedicated original Goo can apply a stun without an authoritative client hook to restore it, and remote fall boots do not establish authoritative fall protection; these require a separate generic multiplayer hook contract
Optional mod fixtures are not part of the portable/default build; no private archives, generated local classes, credentials or test-world files are committed
